question: which embed classes appear in the server-rendered markup of higher-ed home and internal pages, how often, and in what shape
instrument: plain HTTPS GETs, read with the tag tokenizer of src/trim/tokens.ts (no browser, no script execution)

method.site list: the sites of repeat-nav plus EXTRA_SITES (44 picked by the rig author, not sampled); a convenience set
method.pages per site: home plus up to 4 internal links, spread evenly over the links
method.page choice: internal links of the home page: same host, no query or fragment, no asset or account path
method.host rule: a page that lands off the site (www. ignored) is excluded; the rig follows no link off the site
method.requests: GET with fetch, redirects followed, 20 s timeout, 250 ms after each request, 2 sites at a time
method.iframe: host; path with id-like segments as :id; sorted query parameter names, only where the parameter has an =; presence of width, height, title, loading, sandbox, allow, allowfullscreen, srcdoc and class; hero when the class or id matches /hero|ambient|background|bg|loop|banner/i
method.video: presence of autoplay, muted, loop, controls, preload and poster; host of src and of each source src inside the element
method.script: host and provider name for each absolute or protocol-relative src; a relative src has no host and is not recorded
method.inline and data: occurrences of each provider name in inline script text and in data-* attribute values; counts only
method.provider match: scripts: the first listed name found in host plus path; inline and data: every occurrence, longest name first
method.ignored: markup inside a noscript or an HTML comment; iframes skipped that way are counted in noscriptIframes and commentIframes
method.never recorded: full URLs, query values, ids, titles, page text and script bodies
method.limit: server-rendered markup only; an embed that a script injects after load is not seen
